title: patches/rust-oscore-local.patch and README linkage stale after oscore v0.1.2 vendoring
description: Artifact governance from 3x codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-ythw: (1) rust/Cargo.toml [patch.crates-io] now points at the vendored in-tree rust/crates/oscore (v0.1.2, commit 61540bccff) - nothing applies patches/rust-oscore-local.patch anymore, and the patch no longer applies at external clone HEAD 76cee08 (26f2b32 superseded the design: dedicated received_response_piv window instead of response_window+mark_response_used). Decide: delete the patch file, or mark it historical. (2) patches/README.md:33-39 says upstream 'does not ship yet' - false since v0.1.2 shipped begin_unprotect_observe_response and master_secret; the patch-apply instructions would mislead a future session. Rewrite the section for the vendored reality. (3) The external clone keeps uncompiled dead modules (src/context.rs, protect.rs, unprotect.rs, option.rs, crypto.rs, group.rs, types.rs, tests.rs) with pre-fix window-helper copies that mislead audits - delete or wire them (upstream push needs Mark's authorization). (4) Vendored crate: ordinary explicit-PIV responses are now window-checked too but no test pins reordered-but-fresh ordinary responses (observe path has observe_replay_window_accepts_out_of_order_once_and_rejects_old; add the ordinary twin). (5) Vendored crate: add debug_assert!(diff < WINDOW_SIZE) before the unguarded 1 << diff shifts (mark_received_response_piv else-branch ~1500, mark_response_used ~1432) - safe today via the begin->commit invariant, one refactor from a panic. (6) lichen-node secure.rs: a replayed committed CON notification missing the single-slot completed_confirmable cache is dropped silently (no ACK/RST) - harmless while ObserveServer backpressure permits only one outstanding CON; document the coupling or add a MID-keyed ACK cache if multiple outstanding CONs are ever allowed.
close_reason: Completed items 1,2,4,5,6 (+ one security P2). (1+2) patches/README.md rust-oscore section rewritten for the vendored reality: rust/crates/oscore is the build source (61540bccff, [patch.crates-io] -> crates/oscore), carries upstream v0.1.2 content with the manifest version-field caveat noted, both shipped APIs documented, every code span kept on one line so rendered identifiers grep correctly. rust-oscore-local.patch retained as a historical record explicitly marked DO-NOT-APPLY; deleting the file needs Mark's decision under workspace no-delete rules - flagged in the README and this bead's close for the maintainer. (4) New vendored-crate test ordinary_replay_window_accepts_out_of_order_once_and_rejects_old pins the ordinary-path response-PIV window: reordered-but-fresh ordinary responses decrypt, a seen PIV under a FRESH request rejects (isolate case the prior draft lacked - reviewer proved the one-shot guard masked it via a mutant run), and a beyond-window PIV rejects; mutant-verified this round (neutralizing is_received_response_piv_reuse flips the test to FAILED). (5) debug_assert!(diff < WINDOW_SIZE) added before the three unguarded window shifts (mark_response_used/mark_received_response/mark_received_response_piv else-branches); reviewers traced every call path - unreachable in practice, fail-fast on invariant drift, release builds byte-identical. (6) secure.rs comment documents the single-outstanding-CON coupling (completed_confirmable single slot + ObserveServer backpressure; older retransmissions silent-drop with OSCORE PIV replay-reject). PLUS security-P2 fix: vendored crate manifest now carries an empty [workspace] table so its 101 unit tests (incl. both replay-window pins) run IN PLACE - previously dead tests (not a workspace member, no CI step). Item 3 (dead-module cleanup in the vendored/external source) filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-6i9x - needs Mark's upstream-push authorization. Validation: vendored crate 101+9 tests green in place; lichen-node 294 lib + integration suites green; cargo fmt clean (vendored crate formatted, lichen-node pre-existing receive.rs drift untouched); 3x codereview passes (correctness/security/robustness) - all P2s from the passes addressed, remaining P3 doc nits fixed.
